title: Console critical-path deferments and acceptance checklist for dashboards, tracing, and cost breakdown
creator: Priya Nair
description: This ticket captures the agreed deferments to the Console observability surface (dashboards, tracing ingestion UI, and route-level cost breakdown) to meet a gated launch window. It lists decisions, the acceptance checklist for the reduced scope, and the rollout and rollout-backout criteria.
background: Executive decision to prioritize core routing insights and cost delta visibility for GA. The initial scope included rich drilldowns, per-token heatmaps, adaptive trace sampling, and a full-card library. Capacity and telemetry ingestion budget require deferring higher-cardinality features and detailed drill paths so we can ship a stable, low-cost first release.
goals: Ship a coherent minimal observability surface that lets customers detect regressions in latency, error rate, and cost per route
Ensure any deferred features have clear owners and reopening criteria
Keep telemetry ingestion cost within the committed budget for GA
Provide deterministic acceptance criteria so engineering can validate readiness without scope creep
out_of_scope: High-cardinality span attributes in tracing (defer to post-GA work)
Route-level historical retention beyond 30 days for GA
decisions_made: Limit dashboards to 6 compact tiles: route latency (p50/p95), error rate, requests/sec, cost per 1k tokens, active routes, service health
Tracing UI will surface sampled top-level traces with a link to raw trace storage; adaptive sampling and trace search are deferred
Cost breakdown will include per-route daily aggregates and a simple anomaly flag; detailed attribution and per-token costing are deferred
Telemetry retention for GA set to 30 days for metrics and 7 days for full traces; long-term archival is a follow-up
Rollout will be gated by a runbook and a 72-hour burn-in with traffic mirrors for Dedicated customers
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard card set renders within 400ms for 95% of requests in staging under representative load
Route latency and error-rate tiles display correct values against the canonical metrics pipeline (validation against ingestion test vectors)
Cost-per-route numbers reconcile with billing-run summary within +/-5% on test dataset
Tracing surface shows top 10 sampled traces and links resolve to trace storage; trace page load under 1.5s for sampled traces
Feature flags exist to enable/disable deferred features without redeploys
Operational playbook completed, including SLA rollbacks and alert thresholds; on-call runbook verified in chaos test
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged canary (10% traffic) for 48 hours with telemetry and alerting enabled
Progress to 100% over 5 days if no critical alerts; automatic rollback if error rate increases >1.5x baseline or cost delta >20%
Notify top beta customers and dedicated customers 72 hours before rollout; provide migration notes
Post-launch 7-day monitoring window with designated owners for metrics, tracing, and billing anomalies
metrics: Reconciliation delta between console cost and billing engine
Telemetry ingestion rate and estimated monthly cost
Number of incidents attributable to observability UI or ingestion
implementation_notes: Engineering will instrument a low-cardinality metrics layer for GA; avoid high-cardinality tag expansion
Use deterministic sampling policy for traces in GA to keep trace volume predictable
Batch cost calculations daily and surface an estimated real-time delta to limit compute during peak
Provide a simplified API contract for the dashboard to reduce front-end dev time and allow later enhancement
Precompute aggregates in the pipeline to meet dashboard latency SLOs
blockers: Final sign-off on telemetry budget from Finance
Infra capacity for precomputed aggregates (ENG capacity slot remains contested)
Agreement on sampling policy for traces across Dedicated and Hosted tiers
